composition_subtypes.role: Enumerate all valid binary strings with exactly one zero by iterating over bit length (l) and zero position (i)

payload.core_composition_summary: Brute-force enumeration of all numbers with exactly one zero in binary, filtering by range.
payload.rationale: The entire logic is a single nested loop that exhaustively tests all possible (l,i) combinations, which is a complete search strategy without multiple coordinated algorithm types.
